headline_default: Talent Acquisition Specialist | End-to-End Tech & Non-Tech Recruitment | Global Hiring (India, GCC, APAC)
summary: Talent Acquisition Specialist with 2+ years of end-to-end recruitment across IT and non-IT roles, global hiring (India, GCC, APAC), and high-volume campus drives. Consistently delivers 12+ offers per month; improved time-to-hire by 10% and offer-to-join ratio by 15%. Skilled in LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, ATS, HRMS (Keka), and ClickUp. MSc Applied Psychology (HRD).

bullets: Own end-to-end recruitment for Marketing, Product, Sales, IT, SaaS, Construction, Engineering & Manufacturing roles across India, GCC, and APAC markets.
Deliver hiring for Alutec, Cetula, Alumac, BIMTEC and 25+ Aria Holding subsidiaries, partnering with hiring managers to finalize requirements and accelerate decisions.
Issue 12+ offer letters every month with timely onboarding, using ATS, ClickUp, Naukri India & Gulf, LinkedIn, Recruitee, and X-Ray search for sourcing and tracking.
Adapted quickly to a new industry and global hiring practices while managing multiple stakeholders.
Managed the complete recruitment lifecycle — sourcing, screening, scheduling, onboarding — for Product, Engineering, UI/UX, Marketing, Growth & Sales, Accounting, and Analytics roles.
Executed 200+ campus drives across India focused on tech, product, and design hiring; built lateral pipelines via LinkedIn Recruiter Lite, Naukri, Instahyre, Hirist, Indeed, and IIM Jobs.
Improved time-to-hire by 10% and offer-to-join ratio by 15% through structured candidate engagement.
Managed HRMS (Keka), interview coordination, onboarding, and vendor management alongside core admin operations (assets, vendors, office ops).
Recruited 30+ Business Development / Inside Sales candidates and conducted 500+ interviews across profiles.
Led campus drives and hiring presentations across India; managed end-to-end onboarding and induction (LinkedIn, Internshala).
